No absolute set-out date in the feed: dateAdded = first-seen UTC date minus DaysInYard, computed once and kept in the cache. ids wilberts-{stockid}. chains.name: Chuck & Eddie's Self Service
chains.platform: wordpress + yardconnect-pro v1.3.1 (server-rendered table; no search AJAX in this plugin version) — config-driven adapter YARDCONNECT_SITES['chuckeddies']

api.notes: FIRST CONNECTICUT COVERAGE. Chuck & Eddie's is a 3-store CT chain; only the Southington SELF-SERVICE lot (450 Old Turnpike Rd) is inventoried here — New Haven and Hartford are full-service and are deliberately not pins. yardconnect-pro v1.3.1 has no yardconnect_search_vehicles AJAX action (admin-ajax returns 400/'0'); a plain GET of /vehicle-inventory/?make=all&model=all server-renders the whole lot unpaginated (~2.8 MB, ~845 rows). Columns: Image, Make, Model, Year, Body Style, Engine, Yard Row (e.g. 'Left 11', 'Back Holding 1'), Date Set MM/DD/YY. data-stock-number on EVERY row -> ids chuckeddies-{stock}. No VIN. Engine -> _engine extra. Price list /parts-price-list/ (Part name, Part price, Part labor cost; labor ignored, no core column) -> chuckeddies_pricing.json (564 unique parts). Ignore the lorem-ipsum /u-pull-southhampton-2/ template page. Live 2026-10-27: 844 vehicles, newest Date Set 10/26/26.

chains.name: Robertson's U-Pull-It
chains.platform: wordpress + yardconnect-pro v1.3.3 (admin-ajax yardconnect_search_vehicles, table view) — config-driven adapter YARDCONNECT_SITES['robertsons']

api.format: html fragment (one table, whole lot unpaginated with view=table)
api.requests_per_scan: 2 at 2s (nonce page + one search POST)
api.notes: FIRST MASSACHUSETTS COVERAGE. Robertson's Auto Salvage runs a full-service Hollander side (the 'Parts List' nav, robertsons.hollanderstores.com) and a U-Pull-It lot; only the U-Pull-It inventory is parsed. Same flow as U-Pick-It AZ minus the `lot` param: action=yardconnect_search_vehicles&make=all&model=all&engine=&year_start=1949&year_end=2026&view=table (~3.1 MB). Columns: Image, Make, Model, Year, Color, Body Style, Engine, Yard Row (e.g. 'N 2 F'), Date Set MM/DD/YY. data-stock-number on ~94% of rows -> robertsons-{stock}, else sha1 content-hash ids (upickitaz convention). No VIN. Color/Engine -> _color/_engine extras. No price list page. Live 2026-10-27: 561 vehicles (36 hash ids), newest Date Set 10/26/26.
